# Vision9 Solar Inc.

> Vision9 Solar Inc. is an Ontario-based manufacturer of modular off-grid solar racking systems ("Built From the Field Up"), with deep heritage in solar installation and operations & maintenance for residential, commercial, and remote off-grid sites across Canada.

## Contact
- Phone (sales): 705 570 5034
- Email: info@vision9.biz
- Southern Ontario office: Marmora, ON, K0K 2M0 (613 813 4305)
- Northern Ontario office: 519 Government Rd W, Chaput Hughes, ON, P0K 1A0
- Service area: Ontario, Canada (Southern and Northern Ontario), with modular racking shipped Canada-wide

## What we do
- Design and manufacture modular off-grid solar racking ("Built From the Field Up")
- Net metering systems for residential and commercial customers in Ontario
- Off-grid remote power systems for contractors, architects, builders, and developers
- Site analysis, inspection, design, and construction of remote solar sites
- Solar site monitoring, operations & maintenance, and ongoing support
- IT consulting, field IT services, network management & security, backup and disaster recovery
